caption: The drawing depicts a single object placed centrally on a plain background. The object is a lidded container in the shape of a hen sitting on a basket. The basket base features a diamond lattice pattern on its side and a twisted rope-like rim. The lid is sculpted to resemble a hen, with detailed feathers and a defined head, comb, and tail. The body of the hen is smoothly blended into the top of the basket, following its contours. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray pencil on an off-white or beige colored paper, with fine lines and subtle shading to suggest volume and texture. There are no other objects or decorative elements, and the composition is sparse with significant empty space around the central object.
title: Covered Dish (Hen)
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
